headline: In 2008, After 34 Years Working For The Same Company, He Owned More Than 6 Million Shares Of Company Stock. Eight Months Later, The Company Was Bankrupt and The Shares Were Nearly Worthless. The Story Of Joe Gregory Holds An Important Lesson For Every Investor
summary: After three decades climbing to the top of one of Wall Street's most powerful firms, a single executive held millions of shares in the company he had given his career to. Then came the week that changed everything.
